card.title: PS5 EMC error codes: power, VRM, thermal and SoC

claims.statement: PS5 EMC (southbridge) errlog codes, read over UART: 80000001 thermal sensor access fail; 80000004 AC/DC power fail; 80000005 SoC CPU power fail; 80000006 SoC GFX power fail; 80000007 SoC high temperature; 80000009 AC-in detect (12 V); 8000000A VRM hot fatal; 8000000C SoC temperature alert.
80050000 SoC VRM power fail (CPU); 80850000 VRM CPU; 80860000 VRM GPU; 80060004 a VRM problem; C00C0002 VRM controller access error on the 3.3V_VRM line.
80810001 power sequence error; 80810002 power seq NVS access error; 80810013 power seq DRAM init error; 80810014 power seq link-up failure; 80830000 main SoC sync flood.

808D0000 thermal shutdown (SoC); 808D0001/0003 local sensors 1/3; 808D0002 local sensor 2 = LED board thermistor line (THERMISTOR_2_LED): check LED flex/board, and if it persists with them unplugged suspect the southbridge.
C0020303 SoC access error over SB-TSI I2C; 80C00114 SoC watchdog; 80C0012D EMC watchdog; 80C00140 forced shutdown (power held 10 s); 80801F12 and 80801580 suggest APU problems (try reball).

procedure: Look up each code; group power/VRM vs thermal vs SoC.
Follow the matching rail or component.
card.caveats: Community-maintained code list; several entries are marked uncertain on the source. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
